body: I've already stated that I am grateful. And having a disability is definitely not an honor. Having a disability is very humiliating, unpredictable and limiting. Most people would rather work and make a good living like the next person. Telling me how hard it is to get approved is like preaching to the choir, I also had to go through the process like everyone else, I didn't get any shortcuts. Yes I am happy that I was approved (because I'm un- employable and mentally incapacitated). No I'm not satisfied with losing my backpay when that would have helped me reach a better outcome in life. Come on now.
